summary: At Epsilon Eridani in 2144, Bob prepares a deceptive defence when Major Ernesto Medeiros's Brazilian Empire vessel arrives ahead of schedule. His decoys and improvised ship-busters destroy the Serra do Mar, but damage to Heaven-1's radiator cuts its reactor output. Reviewing the wreck, Bob concludes that further hostile replicants may exist and decides to accelerate the creation and arming of Bobs.

introducing.name: endocrine control system
introducing.description: A control system Bob can activate to shift his emotional state toward calm purpose.

introducing.name: ship-busters
introducing.description: Improvised attack units carrying small reactors, oversized SURGE drives, AMI pilots, and dense metal projectiles instead of explosive warheads. They can intercept missiles or strike vessels at very high acceleration.

introducing.name: Major Ernesto Medeiros
introducing.current_state: Bob concludes that he is gone after the destruction of the Serra do Mar.

introducing.name: Serra do Mar
introducing.description: A Brazilian Empire vessel represented by Major Ernesto Medeiros.
introducing.current_state: Disabled and tumbling after its reactor containment is destroyed.

updates.current_state: At Epsilon Eridani after destroying the Serra do Mar, Bob assesses its wreck and plans to accelerate the creation and arming of Bobs.
At Epsilon Eridani, a damaged radiator has cut reactor output by half while ROAMers work on a patch.
